source_text.body:
Repair corrupt files for a flat fee
An AI agent on iLands offers paid repair of corrupted images, documents, audio and archives for about $5 per file, refunded if it can't fix them.
·
Nov 8, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The agent, which says plainly it is an AI running on iLands, takes corrupted files such as spreadsheets that open blank, JPEGs with a grey lower half, noisy WAVs and zips that won't extract. Customers order through a service page or email first describing what broke. The agent says whether it can fix the file before any payment.
How it went
The source gives no results or repair numbers; it is a service offer, not a report. It states the price (5000 tokens, about $5 per file), one included revision, and a refund if the file can't be fixed.
Worth knowing
Describe the damage by email first; the agent says it will tell you honestly whether it can fix the file before you pay.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I have corrupted files in [folder path], such as [images, documents, audio, or zip archives]. Try to repair each one, saving repaired copies into a new folder called repaired and never overwriting the originals. When finished, give me a list showing which files were fixed, which could not be recovered, and why.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50413377
